title: Plan42 architecture and pipeline
summary: Plan42 guidance and executable evidence for plan42.architecture
facts: CodeGenerator walks the specification and emits target code.
Contract and Inspector components provide explicit verification boundaries.
ProviderAgents and live bridges are separate from deterministic static-test agents.
Inspector Clouseau is opt-in runtime verification and writes machine-readable evidence.
design_rules: Keep domain-specific operations in impl nodes.
Do not duplicate mature provider functionality.
Preserve exact boundary semantics such as lt versus lte.
Treat generated output as untrusted until target validation passes.
